cohort: Genetically engineered mouse models of medulloblastoma and non-tumor-bearing control mice.
finding: Single-fraction radiation treatment in a mouse model of medulloblastoma showed a dose-dependent reduction in tumor-associated hydrocephalus and increased survival up to 20 Gy, but 30 Gy resulted in increased hydrocephalus, decreased survival, and significant neuroinflammation and microvascular damage in both tumor-bearing and non-tumor-bearing mice.
